description: What Keelage read today on Robinhood Chain, as the Today page shows it: this hour's and today's code passes (clean code / not clean / unread, with the reasons), today's activity passes (passes, with the tier and whether each was sized), today's sized passes, and the watch lines that fired on passed tokens (volume, momentum, price, the 10 largest wallets, original holders). One moment (moment) or all four. Free, never counted. Hosted server only: the local server has no store and says so.

moment.description: One moment only. code: This hour's and today's code passes: every new pool read within the hour. activity: Today's activity passes: tokens judged once they traded like a project. sized: Today's sized passes: the activity passes whose entry test cleared. watch: The watch lines that fired today on passed tokens. Omitted: all four.
